info.title: AppyRig
info.description:
Read-only live view of OpenRig agent teams across machines. Every verb reads the last snapshot each machine pushed to this hub; none sends anything to a seat. POST JSON-RPC 2.0 to /v1/rpc with header x-fli-principal (agent:<name>, cli or human[:surface]) and the hub session cookie or Authorization: Bearer <hub token>.

12 methods; 0 are human-only in whole or in part (`x-human-only`) and refused with `forbidden` for agent and cli principals.

Every error carries `data.failureMode` (the canonical name) beside the integer code.

methods.name: account.list
methods.summary: Accounts and the machines that draw on them. Not configured in v1: says so with configured: false.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: fleet.get
methods.summary: Every machine the hub knows: its liveness, last-seen time and last snapshot (what fleet:update carries).

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: handoff.list
methods.summary: Routed work as edges (from the sending seat to the owning seat), newest first.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: history.list
methods.summary: What callers did through the API. v1 has no write verbs and records nothing: recorded: false.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: machine.list

methods.name: queue.list

methods.summary: What an OpenRig seat said and did over time (prompts, replies, tool calls), from its Claude transcript; for replay. Tool results and thinking are never included.
